title: US fugitive wanted for sexual offense arrested in Cebu

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An American man wanted in the United States for a sexual offense involving an incapacitated person in Mississippi has been arrested in Cebu, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said Tuesday. The BI said its Fugitive Search Unit (FSU) arrested the 62-year-old American fugitive on Sept. 24 in Barangay Buaya, Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, following a request from the U.S. government through its embassy in Manila.
